methods.body: const axis=this.axis;const size=axis=="x"?"width":"height";const kids=this.laid();const flexing=c=>c.flexes===true;let each=0;let flexN=0;for(const c of kids)if(c.visible&&flexing(c))flexN=flexN+1;if(flexN>0){let content=0;let visN=0;for(const c of kids){if(!c.visible)continue;visN=visN+1;if(!flexing(c))content=content+c.footprint()[size]}const extent=this.contentExtent(size);each=Math.max(0,(extent-content-this.spacing*Math.max(0,visN-1))/flexN)}const al=this.align;const cross=axis=="x"?"y":"x";const crossSize=axis=="x"?"height":"width";const crossOf=c=>{if(flexing(c))return{lead:0,extent:c[crossSize]};const fc=c.footprint();return{lead:axis=="x"?fc.y:fc.x,extent:fc[crossSize]}};let line=0;let lineBase=0;if(al!="none"){if(al=="baseline"&&axis!="x")this.refuseStackBaseline();for(const c of kids){if(!c.visible)continue;line=Math.max(line,crossOf(c).extent);const b=c.baseline;if(al=="baseline"&&typeof b=="number")lineBase=Math.max(lineBase,b)}if(al=="center"||al=="end")line=Math.max(line,this.viewExtent(crossSize))}let pos=0;return kids.map(c=>{const flex=c.visible&&flexing(c);const f=flex?null:c.footprint();const lead=f==null?0:axis=="x"?f.x:f.y;const box=axis=="x"?{x:pos-lead}:{y:pos-lead};if(flex)box[axis=="x"?"w":"h"]=each;if(al!="none"){const co=crossOf(c);const leadC=co.lead;let off=0;if(al=="center")off=(line-co.extent)/2;else if(al=="end")off=line-co.extent;else if(al=="baseline"&&axis=="x"){const b=c.baseline;if(typeof b=="number")off=lineBase-b;else if(c.visible)this.refuseBaseline(c)}box[cross]=off-(al=="baseline"?0:leadC)}if(c.visible)pos=pos+(flex?each:f[size])+this.spacing;return box})

methods.body:
const me = this.root.classNode(name)
        if (me == null) return []
        return me.chain.slice(1).map((id) => this.root.classNode(id)).filter((c) => c != null).map((c) => ({
            name: c.name, lead: this.root.plainLead(c.doc || ""),
            reads: c.reads || ({ theme: [], provided: [] }),
            n: c.reads ? c.reads.theme.length + c.reads.provided.length : 0,
            attributes: c.attributes.map((a) => ({ name: a.name, label: a.name + ": " + a.type })),
            methods: c.methods.map((m) => ({ name: m.name, label: m.signature })),
            events: c.events.map((e) => ({ name: e.name, label: e.signature })) }))
